name: Green-veg & chicken glass-noodle stir-fry — soy-free (clean sauce)

source.notes: Reconstructed 2026-08-26 from a screenshot of this recipe's card in the Recipe Library artifact — the original analysis session/JSON for this recipe was not found in this repo, so this file recreates it from the visible per-100g values, ingredients, and tags on the card. Analysis text (him/her_preconception) is my own re-derivation since the original wasn't visible in the screenshot.

serving_desc: ≈410 g cooked (batch ÷4). Logged batch: 630g raw chicken + 150g dry glass noodles
steps: Prep everything first — stir-fry moves fast. Soak the glass noodles in warm water until pliable (5-10 min), drain, and snip shorter with scissors.
Steam or blanch the broccoli ~2 min (it's the densest veg), then drain — this cooks it evenly and keeps it bright and crisp-tender.
Pat the chicken strips dry and season lightly. Heat the pan/wok hot before the oil goes in — high heat sears, low heat steams.
Stir-fry the chicken in a single layer until just cooked, then remove (crowding makes it grey and watery).
Stir-fry the garlic and onion briefly, then the mushrooms — leave the mushrooms undisturbed ~1 min to brown (moving them too soon makes them release water and steam).
Add the zucchini and blanched broccoli and toss 2-3 min to keep them crisp-tender.
Return the chicken, add the noodles with a splash of water, the sesame oil and 1 tbsp soy sauce; toss 1-2 min to combine and heat through (taste before adding any more salt).
Fold in the spinach at the very end and toss just until wilted — seconds only; overcooking dulls it and loses folate.
Finish off the heat with a squeeze of lemon or lime — it brightens everything and boosts iron absorption. Serve promptly.

him.verdict: High-protein, high-veg, low-sodium stir-fry — a clean cutting/muscle meal with a big folate hit from the spinach/broccoli/zucchini and decent selenium/zinc from the chicken. The single-tablespoon soy sauce (across the whole batch) keeps sodium unusually low for an Asian-style stir-fry.
suggested_mods: Already well-balanced — the portion is flexible per the card's per-100g design, so scale to fit remaining daily calories/protein

her_preconception.verdict: Strong preconception profile — high folate (spinach + broccoli + zucchini), choline and iron from the chicken, vitamin C from the veg to aid iron absorption, and no raw/high-risk ingredients since everything is cooked through.
prenatal_highlights: vitamin C pairs with the iron for absorption
suggested_mods: Keep the spinach addition brief (as instructed) to preserve its folate
